title: 第19章 达到御空境傻缺牢房练飞行第20章 真是亲父女做过DNA检测吗
lines: 石牢内，叶风正在盘膝打坐。
他最近打坐时，感觉十分的玄妙。
就像是置身在一个缓缓转动的旋涡之中。
让他的脑袋有一点点眩晕，但更多却是流淌在身体内外的一股看不见摸不到的力量带给自已的轻盈失重的感觉。
修炼者面临的第一道大难关，便是第四层境界，它有很多名字，比如御空，控物，御剑等，只有达到了这一境界，才有别于凡人。
在前三重修炼的是气，通过气来拓展经络，净化体内杂质，开辟丹田等等。
但御剑却不是以气御剑，而是以意御剑。
第三重百脉，到第四层御空，就像是质的转变，从气变成了意。
而这种意，用修真者的话来表示，叫做念力。
在这将百脉连接之后才诞生的一种全新的力量，念力产生于心。
修士心念一动，剑诀施展，万千剑影遮天蔽日，指的就是这一点。
催动法宝，远距离控物，甚至是御空飞行，依靠的也是自身念力催动灵力。
这几天叶风能感受到自已念力很强了，但是却连最小的一块小石子都无法隔空控制。
老人说，叶风这种情况，并不是念力不够，而是缺少了一朝顿悟。
只是这一朝顿悟，卡住了成千上万修士。
它就像是筛子一般，将庸才挡在仙门之外，从聪慧者进入仙门。
外力是帮不了的，只能凭借自已对仙法的理解。
从昨天开始，叶风就停止了试图控制小石子，而是盘膝打坐，尽量的清空繁杂的思绪。
欲速则不达，修士越是想顿悟，反而越难。
当清空纷乱思绪之后，叶风的心进入到了前所未有的宁静之中。
没多久，他就感受到了身体似乎在随着旋涡旋转。
他并没有抵抗这股旋转之力，而是将身体融入其中。
他以为这自已修炼过程中产生的某种心灵上的错觉。
其实他错了。
此刻叶风虽然是盘膝而坐，而身体却是缓缓腾起，在距离地面大概一米左右的位置缓缓旋转。
头顶上方凝聚着淡淡的霞光雾气。
这是突破境界时，需要大量的灵力支撑，周围灵力汇聚于此，并不能在第一时间被吸收到体内，在身体周围形成的浓郁灵气。
这种奇妙的感觉持续的时间很长，足足七八个小时。
可是对于叶风似乎只有十几分钟。
当他适应被融入到那种旋转力量后，便开始试图控制这股力量。
此刻叶风可以清楚的看到，自已体内也在发生着剧烈的变化。
丹田旋转的速度越来越快，奇经八脉里的灵力疯狂的吸收进丹田之内。
丹田就像是变成了一个无底洞，经络里的灵力全部吸收了也没有饱和。
于是乎，丝丝缕缕的灵气通过外界快速的进入体内，灵气迅速的转化成一缕缕微弱的灵力，快的补充到经络中，然后汇聚与丹田。
叶风感觉脑袋无比的清明。
那种微微眩晕的感觉已经彻底消失。
他知道自已终于突破了那道对凡人来说遥不可及的门槛。
叶风心中欢喜至极，他忍住想要收功尝试御空的冲动。
content_en:
In the stone prison, Ye Feng was sitting cross-legged in meditation.
When he was meditating recently, he felt very mysterious.
It's like being in a slowly rotating vortex.
It made his head feel a little dizzy, but more of it was the feeling of lightness and weightlessness brought about by an invisible and intangible force flowing inside and outside his body.
The first major difficulty that practitioners face is the fourth level, which has many names, such as control of the air, control of objects, control of swords, etc. Only by reaching this level can one be different from ordinary people.
In the first three levels, Qi is practiced, and Qi is used to expand the meridians, purify impurities in the body, open up the Dantian, etc.
But the sword is not controlled with Qi, but with mind.
From the third level of Hundred Meridians to the fourth level of Yukong, it is like a qualitative change, from Qi to Mind.
And this kind of intention, expressed in the words of cultivators, is called the power of thought.
A brand-new power was born after connecting the hundreds of meridians, and the power of thought comes from the heart.
This is what the monk is referring to when he has a thought in his mind, casts his sword technique, and thousands of sword shadows cover the sky and the sun.
To activate magic weapons, control objects at long distances, and even fly in the air, all rely on one's own mind power to activate spiritual power.
In the past few days, Ye Feng could feel that his telepathy was very strong, but he couldn't control even the smallest pebble.
The old man said that Ye Feng's situation was not due to a lack of mental power, but a lack of sudden enlightenment.
But this sudden enlightenment stuck thousands of monks.
It is like a sieve that keeps mediocre people out of the immortal gate and allows the smart ones to enter the immortal gate.
No outside force can help, you can only rely on your own understanding of immortal magic.
Since yesterday, Ye Feng stopped trying to control the pebbles and instead sat cross-legged to meditate, trying his best to clear his complicated thoughts.
Haste makes waste, and the more a monk tries to achieve enlightenment, the harder it becomes.
After clearing his chaotic thoughts, Ye Feng's heart entered an unprecedented tranquility.
Not long after, he felt that his body seemed to be spinning with the vortex.
He did not resist the force of rotation, but integrated his body into it.
He thought this was some kind of spiritual illusion that occurred during his cultivation.
Actually he was wrong.
Although Ye Feng was sitting cross-legged at this moment, his body slowly rose up and slowly rotated about one meter above the ground.
There is a faint haze of twilight above the head.
This is when breaking through the realm requires a lot of spiritual support. The surrounding spiritual energy gathers here and cannot be absorbed into the body at the first time, forming a rich spiritual energy around the body.
This wonderful feeling lasted for a long time, a full seven or eight hours.
But it seemed that Ye Feng only had ten minutes.
As he adapted to being integrated into that spinning force, he began to try to control it.
At this moment, Ye Feng could clearly see that drastic changes were also taking place in his body.
The Dantian rotates faster and faster, and the spiritual power in the Eight Extraordinary Meridians is absorbed into the Dantian crazily.
It was as if the Dantian had turned into a bottomless pit, and even though all the spiritual energy in the meridians had been absorbed, it was still not saturated.
As a result, strands of spiritual energy quickly entered the body through the outside world. The spiritual energy was quickly transformed into wisps of weak spiritual power, which was quickly replenished into the meridians, and then gathered in the Dantian.
Ye Feng felt that his head was extremely clear.
The slightly dizzy feeling has completely disappeared.
He knew that he had finally broken through the threshold that was out of reach for mortals.
Ye Feng was so happy that he resisted the urge to stop and try to control the sky.
title_en: Chapter 19: Reaching the Yukong Realm and practicing flying in the Silly Que Prison Chapter 20: Have the real father and daughter done a DNA test?
